name: tensor-ee
summary: Experimental building blocks for running pretrained PyTorch models natively in Google Earth Engine: a restricted CNN compiler (the SegWater U-Net; standard SMP Unet and UnetPlusPlus on ResNet and VGG encoders), a converter for supported attention models (SMP SegFormer-B0; SMP UPerNet with timm's Swin-T), and a planner and runner for staged exports.
author: Noel Ivan Ulloa
